operators.name: custom_cat

parameters.name: x1
parameters.shape: [512, 3, 256, 256] on reference inputs; supports arbitrary batch/channel/spatial dimensions
parameters.layout: supports strides; must be contiguous or acceptable to custom implementation

parameters.name: x2
parameters.layout: supports strides; must be contiguous or acceptable to custom implementation

semantics: Concatenates x1 and x2 along the specified dimension, equivalent to torch.cat((x1, x2), dim=dim).
Output shape: same as x1 except dimension dim becomes x1.shape[dim] + x2.shape[dim].
Output is a new contiguous tensor with data copied in order: first all elements of x1, then all elements of x2 along dim.
No broadcasting or dtype promotion beyond the input dtypes; both inputs must have same dtype and device.
Supports arbitrary tensor shapes that are compatible along non-concatenation dimensions.

operators.name: custom_rot90

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: [512, 6, 256, 256] on reference inputs; supports arbitrary 4D tensor
parameters.layout: supports strides; input may be non-contiguous (e.g., after cat), custom kernel must handle arbitrary strides or make contiguous copy

semantics: Rotates the input tensor by 90 degrees k times in the plane specified by dim0 and dim1.
Equivalent to torch.rot90(x, k=k, dims=(dim0, dim1)).
For k=1 and dims=(2,3): output[i,j,m,n] = input[i,j,n,width-1-m] for 4D tensor with height H and width W.
Output shape: for k=1, dimensions dim0 and dim1 are swapped (H<->W). For general k, shape depends on k%4.

Output is a view (non-contiguous) in PyTorch; the custom implementation should produce the same logical values and may return either a view-like non-contiguous tensor or a contiguous tensor, but to match reference exactly it should preserve the stride pattern [outer_dims..., 1, original_dim0] for k=1 as indicated in task contract.
Negative k means rotation in opposite direction; must handle k modulo 4 semantics.
Concatenates x1 and x2 along dimension self.cat_dim (which is 1 in reference inputs).
Output shape [512,6,256,256], dtype float32, device cuda:0, stride [393216,65536,256,1].
Rotates the concatenated tensor 90 degrees counterclockwise in the plane of dimensions 2 and 3.
Output shape [512,6,256,256], dtype float32, device cuda:0, stride [393216,65536,1,256].
Returns the rotated tensor, same as checkpoint step_002.
